title: Top 3 Most Spoken Languages in Each Continent

title: Top 5 Languages Globally by Estimated Speakers
description: Find the top 5 languages globally by estimated speakers. Estimate each country-language as Population × Percentage / 100, then aggregate by language.

World share uses total country population as denominator.
Return the result ordered by EstimatedSpeakers descending, then Language ascending.

reference_sql: SELECT cl.Language,ROUND(SUM(c.Population*cl.Percentage/100.0),2) EstimatedSpeakers,ROUND(100.0*SUM(c.Population*cl.Percentage/100.0)/(SELECT SUM(Population) FROM country),2) EstimatedWorldPopulationShare FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code=cl.CountryCode GROUP BY cl.Language ORDER BY SUM(c.Population*cl.Percentage/100.0) DESC,cl.Language LIMIT 5

title: Largest City Relative to Country Surface Area
description: The standard world.city table has no city area, so true city population density cannot be calculated. Instead, for each continent find the city with the highest CityPopulation / CountrySurfaceArea comparison ratio.

Exclude zero surface area.
Return all ties.

Round calculated decimal output columns to 2 decimal places; use unrounded values for filtering and ranking unless stated otherwise.
reference_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT c.Continent,ci.Name CityName,c.Name CountryName,ci.Population CityPopulation,c.SurfaceArea CountrySurfaceArea,ci.Population/NULLIF(c.SurfaceArea,0) ratio FROM city ci JOIN country c ON c.Code=ci.CountryCode WHERE c.SurfaceArea>0),r AS(SELECT x.*,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY Continent ORDER BY ratio DESC) rn FROM x) SELECT Continent,CityName,CountryName,CityPopulation,CountrySurfaceArea,ROUND(ratio,2) PopulationToAreaRatio FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY Continent,CityName

title: Countries Where Two Cities Hold More Than 50% of Population

notes: Require at least two recorded cities.

reference_sql: WITH r AS(SELECT ci.CountryCode,ci.Population,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ci.CountryCode ORDER BY ci.Population DESC,ci.ID) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY ci.CountryCode) cnt FROM city ci),t AS(SELECT CountryCode,SUM(Population) top2,MAX(cnt) cnt FROM r WHERE rn<=2 GROUP BY CountryCode) SELECT c.Name CountryName,c.Population CountryPopulation,t.top2 TopTwoCitiesPopulation,ROUND(100.0*t.top2/c.Population,2) TopTwoPopulationPercentage FROM country c JOIN t ON t.CountryCode=c.Code WHERE t.cnt>=2 AND c.Population>0 AND t.top2>0.5*c.Population ORDER BY TopTwoPopulationPercentage DESC,CountryName

title: Create a Country Summary View
description: Write CREATE VIEW country_summary AS ... so the view returns one row per country: country name, population, city count, official-language count, and most populated city. The evaluator safely extracts and tests the SELECT portion without creating a persistent view.
notes: Avoid count multiplication from joining two one-to-many tables.
Countries with no cities remain.
If largest cities tie, choose alphabetically first.
Return the result ordered by CountryName ascending.
reference_sql: WITH cc AS(SELECT CountryCode,COUNT(*) n FROM city GROUP BY CountryCode),ol AS(SELECT CountryCode,COUNT(*) n FROM countrylanguage WHERE IsOfficial='T' GROUP BY CountryCode),mc AS(SELECT CountryCode,Name,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Population DESC,Name) rn FROM city) SELECT c.Name CountryName,c.Population TotalPopulation,COALESCE(cc.n,0) NumberOfCities,COALESCE(ol.n,0) NumberOfOfficialLanguages,mc.Name MostPopulatedCity FROM country c LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.CountryCode=c.Code LEFT JOIN ol ON ol.CountryCode=c.Code LEFT JOIN mc ON mc.CountryCode=c.Code AND mc.rn=1 ORDER BY CountryName
